intention: Two-player tactical Card battlefield on a Luminati 2.5D diorama: territory mints public Minor Arcana used for Supply, Mana or abilities; formations fight member by member; humans and bots share one deterministic rules module
use_cases: play a complete public-information match locally against a bot or a second person
inspect nine-slot formations, directional hits and why a card or member contributed
run bot-versus-bot experiments across board, combat and resource profiles
replay and verify a recorded match from its manifest and accepted plans
non_goals: hidden information, cryptographic traps or commit-reveal (later game iteration)
commerce, pricing, marketplace or permanent progression policy
public deployment or a central match server
modifying Luminati upstream (engine changes live on the Hapa fork, branch hapa)
